translations.translation: For skin tired from daily irritation and dryness, low-molecular collagen and hyaluronic acid penetrate layer by layer to gently hydrate from within.
Apply while your skin is still damp right after cleansing to help the active ingredients penetrate deeper, keeping your skin hydrated all day long.
It delivers a fresh, non-sticky finish while addressing tightness, making it easy to use even as the first step before makeup.
A firm, adherent texture that creates healthy-looking skin
A dual-hydration formula that leaves the surface feeling fresh while deeply moisturizing the skin.
It gently absorbs even into sensitive skin that tends to flare up with the changing seasons.
The moment it’s applied, a thin moisturizing film forms on the skin to prevent moisture from evaporating.
The centella asiatica extract used in this product is refined from Madagascar-sourced raw materials using a low-temperature extraction method, minimizing the loss of active ingredients.
We recommend applying a small amount to the back of your hand before use to check for any adverse reactions, then using it on your face.
This advertising copy is based on individual user experiences and does not guarantee the same results for all users.
